_comment: TDD M4 read slice: only canonical enabled routes are public (aliases/disabled/dynamic excluded); trusted canonical overrides apply (tools true, reasoning false renders effort values null not raw injection); unknown stays null never false; owned_by=router accepted. RED on baseline in part (owned_by ok, but raw-injection/override shape pending impl).
name: m4_read_api_models_canonical_public
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"
aliases = ["m-a-alias"]

[models.metadata.router.reasoning.effort]
values = ["low", "high"]

[[models]]
name = "m-b"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
enabled = false

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".tools]
supported = true

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".reasoning]
supported = false
